meta.demo_type: USER-SUPPLIED FIRMS CSV — SOURCE NOT INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED
meta.selection: Baseline ships by default. Validation nominates an experimental candidate; never promote without independent evidence
meta.model_note: Logistic regression trained on past satellite-derived history only; no weather features

policy.grid: EPSG:3310, anchored 10,000 m squares; a cell is included when its centre is inside the demo bounds
policy.sensor_metric: active cell-days: unique (UTC date, 10 km cell) with >=1 hotspot; per-sensor counts independent
policy.target: first satellite-observed activity, not confirmed ignition; no detection within 15 km in previous 72 hours
policy.event_boundary: 72-hour lookback across chronological split boundaries; first 3 days excluded
policy.weather: unavailable: NOT used; no next-day weather observations leak into forecast
policy.interpretation: exploratory ranking of likely new satellite-detected activity, NOT a warning or calibrated ignition probability
policy.coverage: FIRMS point presence only. No overpass coverage completeness; an empty day means zero detected, coverage unknown
policy.no_detection: A cell-day with no recorded hotspot is a non-detection, not proof of no fire.
policy.source_filter: If supplied, FIRMS type!=0 (non-vegetation sources) is excluded from fire-history and forecast labels.
